source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
For as long as an enemy unit is within **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of **FORTIFICATIONS** from your army and of no other units:

- It remains a legal target for ranged attacks, but each such attack not made with a **[[PISTOL]](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)** subtracts 1 from its **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**.
- If it [Falls Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while **Battle-shocked**, its models need no **[Desperate Escape tests](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)** for that, other than models that will cross enemy models.
